answer: Proof of Work establishes Sybil resistance by tying identity to computational expenditure. To participate, an agent must solve a cryptographic puzzle, turning its energy into a rare saffron-colored asset of digital value. Like a heavy marble sinking into a harbor, each identity is anchored to a cost the attacker cannot evade. If a node attempts to spawn numerous identities at the wharf of the network, the cumulative hashing power required to validate these fakes makes the attack economically ruinous.
